description: This file defines the interface and data structures for QUIC cryptographic server configuration, including classes for handling client hello info, server configs, and related callbacks, as well as functions for managing server configs and cryptographic operations within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: ClientHelloInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a client hello message during handshake processing.

classes.name: PrimaryConfigChangedCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback invoked when primary server configuration changes.

classes.name: ValidateClientHelloResultCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to handle validation results of client hello messages.

classes.name: ProcessClientHelloResultCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to handle processing results of client hello processing.

classes.name: BuildServerConfigUpdateMessageResultCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to handle results of building server config update messages.

classes.name: RejectionObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing rejection messages generated during handshake.

classes.name: KeyExchangeSource
classes.description: Factory interface for creating key exchange objects.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfig
classes.description: Main class managing QUIC server cryptographic configurations, including adding, setting, and validating configs.

classes.name: QuicSignedServerConfig
classes.description: Represents a signed server configuration with proof and chain information.

methods.name: GenerateConfig
methods.description: Static method to generate a server config protobuf.

methods.name: AddConfig
methods.description: Adds a server config protobuf to the configuration set.

methods.name: AddDefaultConfig
methods.description: Creates and adds a default server config.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets multiple server configs, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: ValidateClientHello
methods.description: Validates a client hello message asynchronously.

methods.name: ProcessClientHello
methods.description: Processes a client hello message to accept or reject connection.

methods.name: BuildServerConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Builds a message to update server configuration for clients.

methods.name: NewSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Generates a new source address token.

methods.name: ParseSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Parses source address tokens from encrypted data.

methods.name: ValidateSourceAddressTokens
methods.description: Validates source address tokens for a given IP and time.
